description: Create an audience of people who fired pixel events (e.g. ADD_CART or VIEW_CONTENT) within N days. Audience only, nothing is delivered. Pixel defaults to SNAP_PIXEL_ID. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

events.description: Pixel events that put a person in the audience, for example PURCHASE.

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

pixel_id.description: Snap Pixel id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_PIXEL_ID. Get it from snap_list_pixels.

retention_days.description: How many days a person stays in the audience after the event (1 to 180).

name: snap_create_pixel_audience
